goal: Stop spamming debug.log with recurring Tor connection warnings when Tor is not running or configured
Preserve warnings when Tor is explicitly configured and log unexpected onion service disconnects
agreement: Strong support for reducing log noise on default nodes without Tor (pinheadmz, winterrdog)
Verified by testing on macOS arm64 and Debian x86_64 (pinheadmz, winterrdog)
Unanswered suggestion to keep failure reasons and warnings when Tor is configured (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it silences roughly 18 recurrent warning lines per hour on default nodes without Tor
The benefit is quality-of-life cleanup for node operators reading debug.log
